name: chauffeur
description: Drive the iOS Simulator from a coding agent, with every action verified.
long_description: chauffeur reads the iOS Simulator's screen as a compact accessibility outline, taps and types through the simulator's HID, and verifies every action: changed, NO EFFECT, INTERCEPTED, NOT DELIVERED, UNVERIFIED, APP CRASHED or APP EXITED. Needs Apple silicon and Xcode 26 or 27 with a booted simulator.

tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: The screen as an outline with refs

tools.name: act
tools.description: Tap, type, scroll, swipe or press a button, verified

tools.name: app
tools.description: Install, launch, terminate or open a URL

tools.name: logs
tools.description: The launched app's log and crash

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: A JPEG of the screen, 1 px = 1 pt
